# Matched as a DOMAIN SUFFIX on a label boundary -- `europa.eu` matches
# The entries that matter are the ones whose TLD this KB's map places:
# a repository that CITES the EU AI Act is not a European repository, and
# `ec.europa.eu` in a `url:` field would otherwise place it in EMEA. That is
# the false positive this file exists to stop, and it is the one most likely
# to appear on an education shelf in 2026.
